notes.title: Update 4.2.0.4
notes.content:
This update includes customizable rep counts for ranked routines, hotkeys for config presets, and general bug fixes.



Added "Reps Count" to routines generated by pressing the "Play As Routine" button in the ranked tab.

Added hotkeys to config presets, you can use to this to assign a key to any config preset and load them instantly while you play. When loading, it will use the settings from the last loaded config preset.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35199965/4ebdb11a6696c7b265df78f1d11f8a15d5269df9.png"]

Fixed Yearly Activity tab showing some played days as gray.

Fixed a bug that caused some scores not to get submitted to the Discord #score-logs channel.



 [img src="https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1100990/extras/steam_discord_banner.jpg?t=1670660464"]

notes.title: Update 4.2.0.3
notes.content:
This update adds training streaks with activity tracking to help you stay consistent, and a new option to launch any ranked playlist as a routine.

Training Activity and Streaks:

This new system tracks how much time you spend on each scenario and monitors your streak of completed training days. The default daily training goal is 15 minutes, but you can customize it to fit your schedule. It's designed to help you stay consistent and motivated to train every day.

You will also be able to see which scenarios you play on a specific day, and how much time and completed sessions you have.

Preview of the daily and weekly activity:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35199965/8a3bd145a6dc873ea0495ff8b45e42cd15193a65.png

Preview of the the yearly activity:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35199965/ac4beda129d424e1b2e33dfd3aa37a4318beb9ac.png

Play Ranked Playlist as Routine:

With this new feature, you can now run any ranked playlist as a routine directly from the Ranked tab. Just go to Play > Ranked and click the "Play as Routine" button on the right-hand side.

View Ranked Requirements:

Added a new tooltip button in the pause and end session menus that lets you view ranked requirements. For normal scenarios, it shows the top percentage needed per rank; in ranked playlists, it shows the score thresholds.

Other Changes:


 Fixed a bug causing the timer to not pause while in the pause menu in free play scenarios.

notes.title: Update 4.2.0.2
notes.content:
This update introduces enhancements to offline mode, new bot outlines, several bug fixes, and various quality-of-life improvements.

Offline Mode Improvements:

Offline mode now supports cached scenarios, allowing you to play previously played and saved workshop scenarios from the Steam cache. Additionally, all scenarios in a routine will be downloaded and cached when the routine is downloaded.

This enables you to play routines containing workshop scenarios. Note that scores won't be submitted to leaderboards while in offline mode.

Bots Outlines:

We're introducing bot outlines for greater customization, these outlines function just like those in Arena mode. You'll be able to control the Color and the Thickness of it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35199965/576324fc556216f391935350ed9178ea273dbfd8.png

Other Changes:


 Fixed error "File Not Found" when uploading or updating a routine with a custom thumbnail.
 Fixed a bug that caused the Pause Menu and End Session tabs to ignore any keyboard inputs. (For example when pressing Escape to go back from Settings to Pause Menu).
 Added the ability to rename a scenario from the scenario manager.
 Added the ability to apply a scenario for verification from the scenario manager.
 Added the ability to rename a routine from the routine manager.
 Added a button in the Statistics tab to be able to delete a statistics file.
 Fixed a bug that caused Ranked scenarios statistics to save with the incorrect name.
 The Challenge/Freeplay switch and the routines Workshop/Local switch will now save and load when launching the game.
 Fixed Report Bug and Report Feedback not working correctly.

notes.title: Update 4.2.0.1
notes.content:
This update adds an offline mode that will allow you to play the game even without an internet connection, and a drag & drop system to routines to improve the experience when moving around scenarios.

Offline Mode:

Offline mode is available when logging in without an internet connection or if the login process fails.
In this mode, you can play locally saved scenarios and routines, as well as create new ones.

Routine Scenarios Drag & Drop:

You can now drag and rearrange scenarios within the Routine Settings and Routine Create tabs. This new system replaces the previous one, which used small arrow buttons, offering a faster and more intuitive way to manage the order of scenarios.

Other Changes:


 Fixed a bug that caused normal scenarios to be treated as ranked scenarios in routines.
 Fixed a bug where the Local Routines tab would endlessly load if no routines were saved locally.



https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1100990/extras/steam_discord_banner.jpg?t=1670660464

notes.title: Update 4.2.0.0 - New Ranked Playlist
notes.content:
This update includes a new Ranked Playlist made by Aimbeast, adding three new ranks (Ruby, Amethyst, and Supreme) and several visual reworks to rank badges.

New Ranked Playlist - Aimbeast V2:

This patch introduces a new ranked playlist by the Aimbeast team, featuring 16 scenarios each for Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced levels. 

It's designed to be more balanced, particularly for beginners, with clearer difficulty progression between categories for smoother skill development.

The previous Aimbeast ranked playlist will still be available to play.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35199965/33cbfea0abb3b933e4dcd97d9b9aadbdc53cf453.png

Rank Badges Reworks:

We are also reworking the ranked badges and adding three new ranks: Ruby, Amethyst, and Supreme.

The new rank badges and ranks will be used in Normal scenarios, Ranked (Only in the Aimbeast V2 playlist), and Arena.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35199965/58de18a2f6d8ffbaf3a984596614dd6dc504e1bc.png

Arena Changes:

Arena has been updated with rebalanced ranks while maintaining the maximum rank at 4000 SR. This should ensure smoother progression through the ranks. The SR amount for winning or losing a duel also changed slightly to be more consistent.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35199965/7d280e3b96a35548797c4c37e46dd4c9c64ec7aa.png

Normal Ranking:

Added the three new ranks to the normal rankings and rebalanced the top % needed to achieve each rank.

Bronze I: Top 100%
Bronze II: Top 90%
Bronze III: Top 80%
Silver I: Top 72%
Silver II: Top 64%
Silver III: Top 56%
Gold I: Top 50%
Gold II: Top 44%
Gold III: Top 38%
Platinum I: Top 34%
Platinum II: Top 30%
Platinum III: Top 26%
Diamond I: Top 22%
Diamond II: Top 20%
Diamond III: Top 18%
Ruby I: Top 16%
Ruby II: Top 14%
Ruby III: Top 12%
Amethyst I: Top 10%
Amethyst II: Top 8%
Amethyst III: Top 6%
Master I: Top 4%
Master II: Top 3%
Master III: Top 2%
Grandmaster I: Top 1%
Grandmaster II: Top 0.75%
Grandmaster III: Top 0.5%
Supreme: Top 0.1%

Hyperlinks:

You can now use hyperlinks to open scenarios and routines, you can find and copy the hyperlink from Play > Custom > Scenarios Manager, or Play > Routines > Local > Routines Manager.

New Bot Settings:


 Normalize Movement Speed -> Adjusts the bot's horizontal movement speed to maintain a constant overall speed with the fly speed.
 Speed Scaled Acceleration / Deceleration -> When enabled, the acceleration to full speed and deceleration time will depend on fly speed. It will take less time to reach lower speeds and more time to reach higher speeds.
 Override Movement Direction with Blink Direction -> If enabled, the bot will update its direction to be the same as the blink direction when the blink ends.
 Join Directions Below Cooldown -> If enabled, the bot will join directions that will happen in less time than the cooldown, and restart their timer.



Other Changes:


 Added Min / Max settings for the pitch increase / decrease amount settings in the Audio tab.
 Added a Min / Max global pitch scale setting in the Audio tab.
 Added a new option called "Single Audio Instance", if enabled only one instance of a sound is allowed to play.
 Reworked the ranked playlist selection tab and improved the look of the logos.
 Improved loading times when first launching the game.



https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1100990/extras/steam_discord_banner.jpg?t=1670660464

notes.title: Patch 4.1.2.4
notes.content:
This update allows players to import their own sky textures and introduces sky theme and color randomize buttons. It also includes a new "Send Feedback" button and new bot settings.

Import Custom Sky Theme:

Just like you can import textures to use on your walls and floors, you can now import a custom sky texture! 

Custom Sky Themes will also save in Config Presets, so you can share them with your friends!

Supported file type: JPG
Suggested sizes: 2048x1024, 4096x2048, 8192x4096

FOV in Leaderboards:

The FOV will now show in the leaderboard alongside the sensitivity used, it will only show up on scores achieved in Patch 4.1.2.4 and after.

Weapon FOV Options:

You can now control the FOV of your weapon model in the Trainer and in Arena!


 Weapon Model FOV -> Controls the FOV of the weapon in the Trainer.
 Weapon Model FOV (ADS) -> Controls the FOV of the weapon when in ADS in the Trainer.
 Weapon Model FOV (Arena) -> Controls the FOV of the weapon in Arena.


Feedback Button:

In the Menu you will now find a "Send Feedback" button, use it to share with us feedback or suggestions about Aimbeast!

New Bot Settings:


 Jetpack Deactivation Chance -> The chance of the bot deactivating the jetpack after it runs out of time, if this fails it will restart the time, and keep the jetpack active.
 Jetpack Min Floor Clearance -> If the distance between the bot and the floor is less than this value, the jetpack will activate.
 Back Angle Multiplier -> Allows you to control the back angle separated from the forward angle multiplier.
 Blink Forward Angle Multiplier -> Allows you to control the forward angle of the blink.
 Blink Back Angle Multiplier -> Allows you to control the back angle of the blink.


Other Changes:


 Fixed a bug that caused some players to get stuck on Loading Verified Items when launching the game.
 Fixed an issue with some texts in the settings tab appearing smaller than others.
 Added a new block to the map editor: Angle 1x1 E


Notes:

We are currently working on the next iteration of the Aimbeast Official Ranked Playlist, alongside improvements to our ranked system.

We will let you know more about it when we are close to release, thank you for the support!


https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1100990/extras/steam_discord_banner.jpg?t=1670660464

notes.title: Patch 4.1.2.3
notes.content:
This patch adds new bot shading options to make bots look more volumetric, a new jetpack fly mode for bots, a time range filter for statistics, and additional bot settings.

Bots Shading:

This new feature allows bots to look more volumetric and 3d by adding lighting to their model, which can also help with depth perception. List of the settings included:

Enable Bot Shading? -> If enabled, bots will receive light and shading, this can help with depth perception and provides more volume to bots models.
Bot Shading Light Intensity -> The intensity from 0 to 150 of the shading light.
Bot Shading Light Color -> The color of the shading light.
Bot Metallic -> Adjusts the metallic of the bot.

*The Bot Shading will be enabled by default with an Intensity of 1.0, but can be disabled in Settings > Graphics.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35199965/d8d98bf03a5e148290f8a75ec70b3170e60c44bc.gif

New Bots Fly Mode - Jetpack:

This new fly system is great when you want to make your bot fly but still be affected by gravity, it works by adding a force over time to the bot. List of the settings included:

 Jetpack Randomize Activation Interval
 Jetpack Activation Interval
 Jetpack Activation Chance
 Jetpack Activate when Grounded -> If enabled, the jetpack will always try to activate when the bot is on the ground.
 Jetpack Randomize Force
 Jetpack Max Speed
 Jetpack Force
 Jetpack Time to Full Force -> The time (in seconds) it takes for the jetpack to go from 0 to Jetpack Force. 0 = Instant full force.
 Jetpack Force Duration (MIN/MAX)
 Jetpack Falling Braking Speed -> The rate at which the jetpack attempts to halt downward motion while active. 0 = No braking.
 Jetpack Min Ceiling Clearance -> If the distance between the Bot and the roof is less than this value, the jetpack will deactivate and reset its interval.

Plus, added these general settings to bots:

 Limit Terminal Velocity -> If enabled, limits the velocity of the bot when falling to the Terminal Velocity value. If the bot exceeds the Terminal Velocity then it will slow down based on the Drag without going lower than the Terminal Velocity.
 Terminal Velocity
 Terminal Velocity Drag

Statistics Filters:

Added the following statistics filters:

 Last 3 Days
 Last 14 Days
 Time Range -> View your statistics within a chosen time range using DD-MM-YYYY dates.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35199965/c630bd28aea44ed538b9e5de332ca40b1e366a3f.png
Reworked Bots Debug:

The bots debug view that can be activated with "Alt+8" got fully reworked to improve visibility and with added information to it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35199965/d80abb6bb1d90b0e58eb4907aebfbc4f1af41fd8.png
Other Changes:

 Fixed a bug that caused only the last scenario/routine to get downloaded when trying to download multiple ones.
 When favoriting a scenario, it now automatically adds a like, boosting the promotion of scenarios.
 Added the "Restart" button even when completing a routine to restart the current scenario.
 Added "Bot Scale" multiplier when playing in Free Play, multiplies the bot scale by this value.
 Fixed a bug that caused some events not to update the spawn protection when destroying the bot.
 Fixed a rare occasion where the game would freeze while refreshing the scenarios list.
 Added "Verification Guide" button to the scenarios manager to quickly open the scenarios verification guide.


Join our discord to share your feedback and suggestions!


https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1100990/extras/steam_discord_banner.jpg?t=1670660464

notes.title: Patch 4.1.2.2
notes.content:
This patch includes several suggestions submitted in the Aimbeast Discord server, like trending scenarios from the last 24 hours, spawn points multi-select, crosshair export to PNG, auto-fire toggle, and new bot settings.

Trending Scenarios:

The top 3 most played scenarios in the last 24 hours will now show in the play tab, cycling with the weekly challenges. 

Ranked scenarios and weekly challenges are excluded from this list.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35199965/4da29b11e878e555693059244c15030af1fa93d1.gif

Spawns Selection Tool:

This new tool allows you to select multiple spawn points in a selection box easily.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35199965/5e196fe89029b8492b755110084161f8a693a0eb.gif

New Scenario Settings:


 Moved all spawn overlap protection settings into their category.
 Spawn Overlap Protection Shape -> This can be either Sphere (which was the default before) or Box.
 Spawn Overlap Protection Box Extent -> The size of the box (per axis) if the protection shape is set to box, note that this box will be oriented based on the spawn rotation, X is forward/back, Y is left/right and Z is up/down.
 Spawn Overlap Protection Refresh Before Spawn -> If enabled, the spawn protection will refresh around all active bots, this only works with the spawn protection type set to "Time".


Auto-Fire Toggle:

This new feature allows you to avoid having to hold down the fire button in scenarios where the weapon has infinite ammo and is set to full auto.

The default keybind to toggle it on/off is "Middle Mouse Button" and it can be changed in Settings > Controls.

Crosshair Export To PNG:

Added a new functionality to the crosshair editor that allows you to export your crosshair to a PNG.

This can be useful in case you want to save your crosshair or share it with friends.

New Bot Settings:

Added the movement profiles manager, this allows you to edit the name of a movement profile, delete it, or duplicate it.


 Movement Time Scale -> Adjusts the overall speed of the bot, including both fly systems.
 Enable Movement / Fly Dodge Cooldown -> If enabled, after changing any direction, the bot applies a cooldown time to all dodge timers that have remaining time below the cooldown value. This can be useful to prevent the bot from changing two directions in a very short amount of time.
 Movement / Fly Dodge Cooldown (MIN/MAX)
 Event Trigger: Direction Changed (U/D) -> Triggers any time the bot changes direction up and down with the fly system.
 Event Triggered: Speed Up/Down (Fly) -> Updates the speed of the V2 fly system. 


Other Changes:


 Fixed a bug that caused routines to show the incorrect current scenario in the end session routine progress tab.
 Fixed a rare bug that caused scores to get submitted to the wrong scenario in routines.
 Fixed a bug that caused some leaderboards to load infinitely.
 Fixed the arena loading screen appearing after a small delay when joining an online server.


Join our discord to share your feedback and suggestions!


https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1100990/extras/steam_discord_banner.jpg?t=1670660464

notes.title: Patch 4.1.2.1
notes.content:
This is a small patch to fix a couple of bugs reported by the community.


 Fixed a bug that caused the Statistics tab to not load properly.
 Fixed a rare bug that caused the leaderboard to display the scores from the previously played scenario.
 Fixed a bug that allowed players to restart a scenario while loading another scenario, causing loading issues.

notes.title: Patch 4.1.2.0
notes.content:
In this update, we've revamped routines for a better user experience, added support for ranked scenarios, introduced a high score bar, added a start countdown timer and new bot settings.

Routines:


 Added support for Ranked scenarios; scores will get submitted in the respective ranked playlist.

 Adjusted the routine progress list in size and moved it from the center to the left.

 Added a routine progress list to the end session tab as well; stats over time are still visible by pressing the arrow near the list.

 Added an option to favorite scenarios directly from the routine progress lists. (Only for Normal and Custom scenarios)

 You can now click on a scenario in a routine (from the menu) and directly start your routine from the selected scenario.

 Progression is now calculated based on how many scenarios you completed, instead of just on the position of the current scenario you are playing.

 Added a Restart button in the end session tab when all reps are finished; by restarting it, you are adding an additional repetition to that scenario.

 Implemented progress animations on scenario completion, and the overall progress color has been changed to green.


Ranked Scenarios In Routine Preview:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35199965/3cb8704685d0212294a319872aa0b64fa55c5139.png

Start Countdown Timer:

This setting allows you to add a small delay before the scenario starts, it can be changed in Settings -> Game.

https://i.postimg.cc/653tGpBz/Countdown-Timer-Preview.gif

High Score Bar:

This is a new HUD element that will show a representation of your high score, compared to your current score. It can be enabled from Settings -> Hud Editor.

It also has a few settings, which are:


 Highscore Type -> This can be set to either ALL TIME BEST, SESSION BEST, or SESSION AVERAGE.
 Bar Color (> Highscore)
 Bar Color ( Multiplies the kill score received by this value.
 Body Hit Score Multiplier -> Multiplies the body hit score received by this value.
 Headshot Score Multiplier -> Multiplies the headshot score received by this value.
 Session Time Size Shifting Type -> Adjusts the size of the bot based on how much time is remaining.
 On Direction Changed (L/R) Event Trigger -> Fires whenever the bot changes direction left / right.
 On Direction Changed (F/B) Event Trigger -> Fires whenever the bot changes direction forward / back.
 Min Jump Ceiling Clearance -> Avoids jumping if the distance from the bot and the roof is less than this value.
 Jump Max Count -> This is setting is in LMP profiles and allows the bot to perform jumps even if in the air but not over this value.


Other Changes:


 Added Sensitivity and FOV options for THE FINALS.
 Fixed a bug that caused routines with 1 scenario to now show in the routine progress list.
 Fixed a bug with projectiles that caused them to never deal an headshot.
 Fixed collision issues with projectiles.
 Fixed bullet spawn point location to be incorrect on bots when using a projectile weapon.
 Fixed a bug that caused the Human bot reload animation to persist even after respawning.
 Fixed a bug that caused bots to shoot towards the camera instead of the player in third person.
 Fixed a bug that caused bots to stop shooting projectile if the player was crouched.
 Fixed animations and effects for Human bots not playing when shooting.
 Fixed a bug where projectiles would travel through walls occasionally.
 Fixed a bug that caused possession to stop working upon restarting a scenario in a routine.


Join our discord to share your feedback and suggestions!


https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1100990/extras/steam_discord_banner.jpg?t=1670660464

notes.title: Patch 4.1.1.9 - New Ranked Playlist
notes.content:
This update introduces a new Ranked Playlist co-developed with the OOT community. Plus, handy config presets for quick settings adjustments, dynamic scenario events, bots color change on hit, and more...

This patch should also reduce stuttering significantly on most systems, especially in Clicking scenarios.

OOT Ranked Playlist:


This playlist contains 2 categories: Beginner and Advanced.
Includes a total of 32 Scenarios.
Check out the OOT Discord Server and Twitter.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35199965/aa3614171f8bb3eb07632a261655fa39d27b24cc.png

Config Presets:

This handy addition lets you save complete configs to a list and load them up in full or just parts of it with one click.

Config Presets will also store custom files such as Custom Sounds, Custom Crosshairs, and Custom Walls and Grounds Textures.

Plus, you will also be able to import / export presets quickly and revert unwanted changes made.

Access the Config Preset Manager via the Menu Settings tab (shortcut: "P" or click "Presets" in the bottom right corner) or from the Pause Menu Settings tab (click the cog wheel button).

https://i.ibb.co/LNZp6ZK/Config-Presets-Preview.gif

Scenario Events:

Scenario events allow creators to add unique events to their scenarios, happening on:


Session Time
Bot Count
Kill Count
Timer
On Start
On Kill


And execute one or multiple events at once such as:


Switch Weapon
Destroy Bots
Cycle Bots (Forward, Back, Random, or Index)
Update Bot Amount


Change Bot Color On Hit:

This new feature lets you choose a different bot color when hitting it, based on the head or the body.


Bot Body Color On Hit
Bot Head Color On Hit
Humanoid Bot Armor Color On Hit
Color Fade Delay After Hit -> This is the amount of time it takes to start fading back to the default color.
Color Fade Duration -> This is the duration of the fade between the hit color and the default color.


New Bots Settings:


Finish Dodge Before Swap -> Only used when Swap Movement Profiles is enabled.
Choose Opposite Dodge Direction On Swap (L/R) -> Only used when Swap Movement Profiles is enabled.
Choose Opposite Dodge Direction On Swap (F/B) -> Only used when Swap Movement Profiles is enabled.
Use Flat Base For Floor Checks


Other Changes:


Revamped ranked score requirements tab to make it easier to read.
Fixed a bug that caused invalid scores to get submitted to the #score-logs channel in the Aimbeast Discord.
Fixed overall session time being affected by timescale.
Added import button for sounds.
Fixed multiple bugs that affected some functions of the Dynamic Blocks.
Fixed a bug that caused the New Playlist Tab to keep loading ranks forever.
Fixed a bug that caused rank and leaderboards entries count to not reset when launching a scenario without any leaderboard entry.


Make sure to join our discord to share your feedback and suggestions!


https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1100990/extras/steam_discord_banner.jpg?t=1670660464

notes.title: Patch 4.1.1.8
notes.content:
Discover the latest patch, offering several new bot settings, a completely revamped fly system, more scenario settings, and performance optimizations. 

Performance Optimizations:


 Enhanced FPS stability and reduced stutters.
 Improved fast restart speed slightly.
 Significant 50%-60% reduction in GPU Memory usage.
 20% faster game launch time.

Revamped Bot's Fly System:

This update brings a completely new and improved version of the bot's fly system, featuring many new settings and customizability.

The V2 Fly System is similar to the standard Legacy Movement Profiles (LMP).

It now works based on acceleration instead of interpolation, which provides smoother movement and much better behavior when colliding with the floor and roof.

All of this while providing a ton of more customization options compared to V1. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35199965/ee65ceeb30e0ea8634bf0f4f5297679aa7ba6133.png

Note: You can still choose to use the old Fly system by just switching to V1 from the dropdown.

New Bot Settings / Changes:


 Added new Size Shifting Type: "Health Based", this will scale the size of the bot based on health with options like: "Size Multiplier at 0 Health" and "Transition Interpolation Speed".
 Fixed blink wall detection not working vertically.
 Blinks can now be set to have 0 as duration, this will make the bot teleport to the end location.
 Added new Event Triggered: "Update Health", this will update the Bot's health.

New Scenario Settings:

 "Spawn Bots Threshold": When this setting is checked, bots will only spawn if the number of active bots Is equal to or lower than the value entered.
 New Spawn Overlap Protection Duration Type: "Bot Lifetime", this essentially keeps spawns disabled for the time the bot stays alive.

Other Changes:


 Fixed a bug that caused only ~200 favorites to load when starting the game. (If you have over 200 favourites expect longer loading times when first loading in).
 Fixed a bug that prevented searching for both Name and Tags in the Normal tab.
 Fixed a bug that caused HUD settings not to get applied.
 Reworked how Custom Scenarios and Routines load to prevent stuttering.
 Reworked how Maps load to prevent stuttering.
 If a custom scenario contains errors, it will now show a popup with a list of the errors when trying to either upload it or play it.
 The customize tab in the map editor will now automatically select the profiles used in that scenario.
 Added 2 new blocks to the map editor: "Angle 1x1 C" and "Angle 1x1 D". 
 Added new debug mode to show if spawners are enabled or not by pressing "Alt-8" twice.
 Fixed a bug that caused textures to become blurry on some systems.
 Added an option to make scenarios private and visible only to selected players.
 Added a popup in the menu that will show the current online members in the. Aimbeast Discord server.


Join our discord to share your feedback and suggestions!

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1100990/extras/steam_discord_banner.jpg?t=1670660464

notes.title: Patch 4.1.1.7
notes.content:
Explore the latest patch, offering a revamped UI for the routines play tab, more bot settings and new dynamic arena events with an enhanced competitive gamemode.

New Arena Feature - Events:

During gameplay, a variety of events will trigger randomly. These events are designed to shake things up and create unique situations. 

Here is the current list of possible events:

 Close Range
 Long Range
 Blink Frenzy
 Longer Blinks
 Mirrored Blinks
 Vertical Blinks
 Headshots Only
 Bodyshots Only
 1.5X Damage
 100% Lifesteal
 Ice Skates

All of these events can randomly stack up to 2 at the same time, for example "Close Range + 1.5X Damage" or "Ice Skates + 100% Lifesteal".

The Close Range and Long Range are unique because they will change the Arena, creating new structure to force those situations, while also having more chance of happening by default.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35199965/da54ce1c0c1c2e09ee5d9e64ae52f69f8d4438d0.png

Arena Gamemode Update:

 Implemented various adjustments to enhance movement fluidity and responsiveness.
 Introduced adjustable Lean variables to improve the readability of opponent movements.
 The default Ranked Arena map has been changed to ArenaV1. (Events such as Close Range and Long Range will work on both maps).
 Enabled Blinks in ranked matches, bringing an additional strategic element to gameplay.
 As part of this update, ranks will reset.


New Arena Gamemode Settings:

 Lean Amount
 Lean Interpolation Speed
 Blink Vertical Offset
 Weapon Category -> Full Auto / Semi Auto
 Headshots Only
 Reload On Hit
 Enable Events
 Events Chance
 Events Chance Round Increase -> The overall chances of an event happening will increase by this amount every round the event doesn't occur.
 Double Event Chance
 Weight settings for all events


Routines Play Tab UI Revamp:

 We are improving the routine play tab to display more information such as scenario Type, Author and even the possibility to favourite scenarios.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35199965/b795f8c52aeefa00a0ca8dfa490bc63baf308411.png

Bots and Map Editor changes:

 Added a Map Editor starting guide when first editing a map, this should help new creators navigate the map editor easier.
 Added new Event Trigger to bots: "On Spawn".
 Added several new fly interpolation types, such as: Ease In, Ease Out, Ease In Out and more...
 The customize tab in the map editor will now automatically select the relative profiles used in the loaded scenario.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35199965/672ebae9e52d4936e51abbe7d2554d8fef521b58.png

Other changes:

 Your Scenarios and Routines favorites lists will now update instantaneously as you favorite or unfavorite items.
 Improved loading times when launching the game.
 Routine thumbnails should now load 10 times faster than before.
 Added a tooltip to the FOV setting that shows all the FOV values for the most popular games.
 Added a new scenarios filter: Author
 Updated the menu banners with new art, animations and functionality.
 Fixed a bug that caused the Spawn Delay to get ignored even when enabled.
 Added average score to Statistics tab, this will show the average score over the last 30 runs.

notes.title: Aimbeast 4.0 - Major Release
notes.content:
Before we head into the details on what this new version offers, we first need to thank all of you for supporting us during this first year. We tried to condense the changes as much as possible but there’s too much to cover, so we included only the major improvements / features below.

[previewyoutube=nOKWBglxzAs;full][/previewyoutube]
Input & Performance

In 4.0 you can expect a 70/100% boost in performance depending on your machine and the game now supports controllers as well. You can choose between input curves to match your game of choice in case you are using a controller, while on mouse and keyboard you can match your sensitivity to other games directly.

UI/UX Overhaul

As you will see when you open the game, everything from the main menu, tabs, visual elements and in-game HUD has changed to give 4.0 a cleaner and unique look while also improving the user experience.

Ranked Mode

Ranked mode is the best way to get an idea of your current skill level in 3 categories: clicking, tracking, switching. You will get a rank ranging from bronze to grandmaster, which will motivate you during your training. On each non-ranked scenario you can also get a rank based on your position on the leaderboard.

Map Editor

We have reworked the map editor from scratch and now it supports more blocks and features, such as moving blocks and teleporters. The look has changed aswell and it’s now much faster to make changes to your maps and scenarios.

Deep Learning AI

The movement system now uses imitation learning so bots can move and behave naturally like a human. Each property and behavior is entirely customizable for every bot you create. You can also choose to use the old math based system, which may work better in some specific cases.

Routine System

We have improved routines a lot and now they can be shared on the workshop so everyone can play or download them locally. While playing routines, you can see the progress from the pause menu and also choose to play the routine in random order if you prefer.

Improved Progress Tracker

The in-game progress tracker now supports both linear and logarithmic regression, which is useful to see where you are reaching plateaus. There are also filters for date and an option to remove outliers from the graph automatically.

In-Game Player Profiles

Each player now has a public profile showing its position on the leaderboard and the global rank and individual ranks (tracking, clicking, switching).

Join our official discord and twitter to get in touch with us and give feedback.

notes.title: Aimbeast - Ranked Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35199965/30b3bb270194acd17976f8aded5a00fb40540d1e.png

We are happy to announce the first season of ranked play. This update includes many improvements to the game, including a new system for making bots move more naturally along with many improvements to the game (check the change log).

The new ranked system will be much more suitable for competitive players, giving a single rank based on 9 scenarios (FOV locked at 103 hdeg res) split into 3 different categories: tracking, click timing and target switching. You can now also see a global leaderboard with all players from the menu and you can sort between the different seasons, each season will last 30 days. You can access the ranked scenarios by filtering ranked scenarios in the normal tab or by clicking the ranked button on the right side.

We hope you enjoy this new update. Another one will come soon with a fully reworked routine system and much more.

notes.title: Aimbeast - Out of Early Access
notes.content:
Before we head into the details on what this new version has to offer, we first need to thank all of you for supporting us. This is just the beginning and we will keep improving the game in the months and years to come so we hope you will enjoy all the new features and changes we added in this new version of the game.

[previewyoutube=Nf1-3CjJbpI;full][/previewyoutube]

SCENARIOS

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35199965/ee4dc8b176b51f21efd454c776f0832bd02f66d9.png
You can explore and play a large amount of community and dev created scenarios, each scenario have a lot of options and can be customized in detail, when you upload a scenario on the workshop a leaderboard will be created and everyone will be able to play it.

ROUTINES

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35199965/53e38765cffa67c859f863f1d50010ae4ec328ac.png

Create automated routines / playlists by combining your favourite scenarios. Every time you play a routine you will see an overview of your performance and you will be able to see from the progress tracker how much you are improving.

HUMAN-LIKE AI

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35199965/2e042608bd23391099c97c9dab62c3bb98a86219.png

Thanks to an advanced movement system bots can move and behave very naturally like a human, the movement system and every bot property and behavior is entirely customizable for every bot you create.

CUSTOMIZATION

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35199965/69e730554a63db01a20d281b810e3f945bea3031.png

Everything in the game is easily customizable from the options menu like: crosshairs, sounds, map textures, HUD, map shading, sky type, third person settings, etc..

LEADERBOARDS

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35199965/1d76a181db4ea22b28cff6cf5ec882b2abcc1c7e.png

Every scenario available in the game has a leaderboard so you can compete with other players and get an idea of your skill level and how much you are improving over time.

WORKSHOP

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35199965/17308eb8cb9dca28abd2acba79ba9558b90ffb4f.png

Workshop is fully supported in the game and players can share, search and download: maps, scenarios, routines, bots, weapons, sounds, themes, etc..

MAP EDITOR

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35199965/3a49825a2cc250e73b2a44e3f7dd5ce084963122.png

Aimbeast offers the best and easiest tools for creating maps and scenarios thanks to a fast and easy to use map editor in which you can easily create, test your maps in real time and then share them on the workshop.

PROGRESS TRACKER

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35199965/094fb54e00eccd55aabeda4df24e8de96f27008d.png

Thanks to one of the best progress trackers on the market. You can see a graph showing how much you are improving over time and you have a lot of filters at your disposal to see your statistics more in depth.

RANKING SYSTEM

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35199965/30b3bb270194acd17976f8aded5a00fb40540d1e.png

On every verified scenario you can see your current rank which is calculated from your position in the leaderboard, you will also be able to see what score you need to achieve to get to the next rank.

Make sure to join our  official discord to get in touch with us and give feedback.
